verdict.summary_en: Boise Semiconductor order acknowledgement OA26817889 for Soony Interactive PO 4500318645 (2026-03-31). It confirms two lines of CMP-GAM-002 (Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5), 10,000 pcs each at 6.11 USD. Item 00010 is confirmed for 2026-04-30 and item 00020 for 2026-05-04. Terms are EXW Boise, payment NET30. Freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by the Seller and added to the invoice. The document is clean print with no handwriting or stamps.
red_flags: Delivery terms are EXW Boise, but the note says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by the Seller and added to the invoice. Under EXW the buyer normally arranges and pays these, so the buyer should check the extra charges against the contract.
The same material CMP-GAM-002 appears on two lines with identical quantity and price but different confirmed dates (2026-04-30 and 2026-05-04), so the total of 20,000 pcs is split across two dates.
The Qty column has no unit of measure, and the document shows no issue date of its own.
observations: Clean printed single-page document; no handwriting, stamps, signatures or strike-throughs.
The 'Qty' column is read as the confirmed quantity; the 'Confirmed' column holds delivery dates.
The order date 2026-03-31 comes from the header line, not from the item lines.
